ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible high-contrast distribution with low-intensity pixels (black/dark-gray) occupying approximately 60% of visible fluke area and high-intensity pixels (white/light-gray) occupying 40%.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellowish-brown staining visible along the transition zones between high-intensity and low-intensity pixel regions on the ventral surface.
